reviews.comment: This Class with Kathryn Kelly should be very approachable for anyone, just make sure you follow instructions well and do what is needed from you and you should have a solid A. Be comfortable coming out of your shell.

Honestly you just have to show up everyday. She only takes university excused absences. It really is not much public speaking. Maybe a couple presentations and one debate at the end of the year but you can just read off your computer.
Lots of assignments, but nothing overwhelming, and they were pretty easy if you understood the material. Interesting class if you're interested in persuasion.

Prof. Kelly clearly cares about her students and wants them to succeed. Her class is quite easy; she will give you step by step tutorials on how to do her assignments exactly how she wants. The major assignments were not too hard and completely doable. Come to class for her occasional attendance assignments or your grade will suffer!!!
Kelly is awesome. Class is super easy as long as you show up and submit assignments. The in class debates are mainly about participation and effort more than anything else. Would recommend for sure.

Shes a really nice person and makes the environment easy to talk in. If your a little introverted like me, then the assignments can be intimidating but she very much makes you feel at ease when it comes to tackling them. Quizzes done at home, a couple of mini debates and then one final debate at the end of the course but overall super easy

This persuasion class was surprisingly enjoyable; she is hilarious and willing to help. Attendance was not technically graded, but she would make an in-person attendance quiz grade if many students didn't attend class that day.

Professor Kelly is great. She makes the class very doable and the workload isn't too much at all. Quizzes are textbook based but manageable and at home. Go to class, she notices. No tests or finals, just two big debates and a group presentation. She is very relatable, reasonable, and even brought her puppy to class a few times!
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Group projects--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: This class and professor is so enjoyable! You do have to show up for attendance, but it is a very easy A for COMM majors. Group project heavy but you get to pick your groups. If you are interested in social media I could not recommend this class more!
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: TAKE THIS CLASS! So easy. You do have to show up to class for attendance points, but I missed a few Fridays to go home and it only affected my grade by a point as long as you work hard on the group projects and exams. No final, and all the exams are online and not proctored. Loved this class and was seriously an easy A as long as you try.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This is by far the rudest, most inconsiderate professor I've ever had. The attendance assignments were ridiculous. I had absences that I reached out to her prior for when I was ill and prevented from coming to class. I had a doctor's note every time, yet she either refused to excuse my absences or would ignore my emails and give me zeros anyway.

Prof. Kelly is one of the best professors I have had. She is a lenient grader, especially so with speeches. Tests are open book, and pretty much the ONLY things to do to get an A is to show up every class, and just follow the directions on assignments.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Is a no BS kinda prof. Grade is made up of mostly 3 debates and 1 exam. Exam was open book and easy. She grades rather leniently for debates, never failing anyone. She understands that students are here for a speech credit
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Class was easy, but I dropped because of the prof (On the first day, she told us that she "is a b***h"). Halfway through the semester, she added in-class assignments that weren't on the syllabus and only told present students, so anyone absent got a 0, didn't know why, and couldn't change it. Lectures were fine, but attendance policy made me mad.
